title: A bounced or failed letter is flagged on open and re-sent from the candidate
deviations_from_card: (1) Critic revision applied: resendDoorOf returns null on REFUSED_COMMS_CHANNEL, and that constant moved beside SIM_COMMS_CHANNEL into comms-resend-outcome.ts (both re-exported by comms-dispatch.ts); the SIM case covers queued-SIM as well as failed-SIM. (2) Added beyond the card (loop closure for 'never target an erased/anonymized entry'): resendDoorOf/lettersNeedingYou take an optional consentStatus; 'anonymized'/'expired' close the door and drop the count. Only the candidate modal passes it (from the bundle's consent snapshot); Channels and the outbox do not know the candidate, so the route's send gate (COMMS_SUPPRESSED) stays the authority there. (3) toCandidateComm recipient case + source guards live in drawerCommsTruth.test.ts (card listed that file); the ChannelsCommsMessageModal failure-reason line also moved to the shared verdict (it read the same raw bits). (4) outboxView.test.ts (outside the write set) pinned OutboxRows' OLD door expression; updated to pin resendDoorOf and still forbid a retry under a bounce / a local verdict door. (5) Catalog keys: pipeline.candidate.needsYou + needsYouAria (ICU plural, cs/de/fr translated).
notes: Integration: drawerCommsTruth.test.ts gained 5 tests in a new block 'one recovery door, three surfaces' (inserted before the PipelineFacetRow block): all three surfaces call resendDoorOf and every <ResendButton>/<BouncedResend> sits under `door|resendDoorOf(...) === "retry"|"correctAddress"`; PipelineCommsList renders both with defaultRecipient={m.recipient}; CandidateModalBody calls lettersNeedingYou( and CandidateModalTabs renders needsYou; comms-dispatch.ts declares no channel literal and imports from ./comms-resend-outcome; a DB-backed toCandidateComm recipient case (dynamic-imports unit-db first). The consent-panel guard in that file is untouched. For card A: PipelineCommsList now takes optional consentStatus and onResent props; onResent is NOT wired yet (the door's own outcome line reports sent/queued/recovered/dead-lettered) - A's bundle invalidate() is the natural thing to pass from CandidateActivityTab. Perf: +1 module (the import-free leaf) on every app/api/**/route.ts graph that reaches comms-dispatch (group 230->231 + 18 overrides, 3afbff2f5) and, after re-measuring on HEAD 07fb82065, page.tsx +1 KB / hire-from-need +6 KB (ca95fc8e4), each measured as this card's files alone in git-archive trees; comments were trimmed first (b8dc6bba8). Still red on HEAD and NOT mine (present with my files reverted): app/page.tsx 1428 modules vs 1427, hire-from-need +1 KB. Full test:unit: only app/_lib/python-runner-concurrency.test.ts red (sibling in-flight python-runner.ts). tsc whole-tree red only on foreign paths (kpi-sim/, app/api/match/engine-busy.test.ts, extract-text, analyze-run.test.ts - sibling work). loop_open: app/features/hiring/channels/channelsCommsHelpers.ts isActionable and app/features/tools/devcases/outboxView.ts isDeadLetter still count a refused-channel `failed` row as needing the recruiter (dead-letter chip / failed-only filter), while lettersNeedingYou does not; those are chase-list predicates that also include orphaned receipts, so aligning them (exclude channel === REFUSED_COMMS_CHANNEL) is a separate card outside this write set.
